title: 香港监管机构调查新股配售安排 涉及31家券商与两宗上市项目
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Hong Kong's securities watchdog is investigating a suspected case of IPO rigging.
segments.zh: 香港证券监管机构正在调查一起疑似IPO操纵案件。

segments.en: Ordering the suspension yesterday of trading in Sichuan, Bae Chao, Bae Daoshes.
segments.zh: 昨日已下令暂停四川百茶百道股份的交易。

segments.en: Let's bring our child across one of Mimin Lo in Hong Kong. So, Mimin, give us the details about what the bid-riching rigging.
segments.zh: 让我们连线在香港的Mimin Lo。Mimin，请介绍一下这次操纵案的具体情况。

segments.en: Let me try that again, activity looks like. Yeah, well, the SFC has said that this could look like companies entering into undisclosed
segments.zh: 我再说一遍，相关活动看起来像是这样。证监会表示，这可能涉及公司与市场参与者签订未披露的协议，

segments.en: agreement with investors, whether it's even financing their share subscription, for example, or pre-allocating shares to selected investors and even guaranteeing their returns.
segments.zh: 比如为市场参与者的股份认购提供融资，或者向特定市场参与者预先分配股份，甚至保证其回报。

segments.en: In some ways, just finding a way to get the IPO proceeds channeled secretly back to connected parties, that's one. But the SFC is also concerned about post-listing activities.
segments.zh: 某种程度上，就是设法让IPO募集资金秘密回流到关联方，这是一方面。但证监会也关注上市后的活动。

segments.en: So, for example, artificially generating a certain level of trading turnover or maintaining a certain market cap, for example, and concealing the ultimate identities of the investors
segments.zh: 例如，人为制造一定的交易额或维持一定的市值，并通过代持结构等隐藏市场参与者的最终身份。

segments.en: through nominees, sort of structures, and so on.
So, this is now being investigated.
segments.zh: 所以，此事目前正在调查中。

segments.en: And at the same time, the SFC also said that a lack of quality in listing applications continue to be a problem, right?
segments.zh: 与此同时，证监会还表示，上市申请质量不足仍是一个问题，对吧？
